-- Task12 frontier3: exact reached helper and extension-default metadata only.
-- No custom calls, business rows, permission rows, sequence state or mutations.
with expected_functions(signature) as (values
 ('public.gridex_jsonb_text(jsonb,text[])'),
 ('extensions.gen_random_uuid()')
), function_oids as (select pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid oid from expected_functions)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at',clock_timestamp(),
 'database',current_database(),
 'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'session_context',jsonb_build_object('search_path',current_setting('search_path'),'current_user',current_user,'session_user',session_user),
 'ledger',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'tail',max(version)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'expected_functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'oid',pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid) order by signature) from expected_functions),
 'missing_functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(signature order by signature),'[]'::jsonb) from expected_functions where pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature) is null),
 'function_dependencies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('function_oid',d.objid,'reference_class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'reference_oid',d.refobjid,'reference_subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.objid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid in(select oid from function_oids)),
 'functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'language',l.lanname,'kind',p.prokind,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'strict',p.proisstrict,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'config',p.proconfig,'definition',case when n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' and p.prokind in('f','p') then pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) else null end,'effective_execute',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),'extension',(select jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on e.oid=d.refobjid and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::regclass where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')) order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where p.oid in(select oid from function_oids))
) as catalog_receipt;

functions.name: gen_random_uuid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.gen_random_uuid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE c
 PARALLEL SAFE
AS '$libdir/pgcrypto', $function$pg_random_uuid$function$

functions.name: gridex_jsonb_text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_jsonb_text(payload jsonb, path text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_extract_path_text(payload, variadic path)
$function$

boundaries: Two exact reached helper/default function metadata projections plus direct catalog dependencies and ledger count-tail only.
No business/customer/permission-assignment rows, sequence values, custom RPC/calls, DDL/DML or provider access.
